component.name: OpenWave
component.summary: Control Elgato Wave hardware and route application audio

description.p: OpenWave is a GTK4 and libadwaita control panel for Elgato Wave audio hardware on Linux, with a PipeWire mixing matrix for application and device sources. Route sources to independent mixes and output devices.

Native installations support user-managed hardware permissions and background services. The experimental Flatpak supplies the panel and routing tools only; host hardware permissions and services must be configured outside the sandbox.
Fix process-test isolation on CI runners and preserve package ownership detection for missing files during interrupted removal and retry.
Breaking release: the Python implementation is replaced by native Rust executables for x86-64 Linux. Update Python-based launch and service commands.
Expanded device support, dynamic mixes, scenes, capture processing, safer ownership and shutdown, and confirmed installation removal.
